files.description:
Long and slow sweeping over a hotspot area.

This is a recording of an EBERLINE E-120 Geiger counter, which makes the "classic" Geiger click sound. Recorded with a RØDE NT-1 at about 4 CM (1.6") from the speaker.

Click here to check out the full Geiger sound pack.
